build_PPOAlgorithm: build a PPOAlgorithm instance with a batch environment, training step, and config object
create_begin_episode: create a begin_episode call to reset recurrent states and stored episode buffers for agent indices
run_perform: run perform to compute a batch of actions from observations using the current policy network
test_experience: test the experience method to process transition tuples and update streaming statistics during training
review_policy_loss: review the policy_loss method to understand the PPO surrogate loss, KL penalty, and KL cutoff components
